$comment: Data input for Trivy's KSV0125 check ('Restrict container images to trusted
The check's built-in default trusts Azure ACR, AWS ECR and GCR only, so it
reports every ghcr.io image as coming from an untrusted registry. That is a
finding about the check's default configuration, not about this repository -
and .security/POLICY.md 3(b) says findings in the pipeline get fixed rather
than baselined, so the registry list is stated here instead.
Note that supplying this key REPLACES the defaults rather than adding to
them (the check uses the override whenever it is non-empty), which is why the
ECR host for the region in deploy/terraform is listed explicitly.
Anything not on this list fails the scan. That is the point: it is the
allowlist of registries this project is willing to run code from.
